# Guchho

> Fast HTML-first JavaScript, CSS & asset bundler.

Guchho is a fast, native bundler, compiler, and build tool for modern web applications. It parses HTML, JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX/TSX, CSS, and assets, then produces a complete, deployable output directory.
